on_screen_text.text: Jack Harlow on the campaign trail with Democratic governor of Kentucky, Andy Beshear
First and foremost,
I just want to say thank you
to Andy for having me.
I want to say thank you to everybody
for pulling up today, this is really special.
I remember about a year ago,
I was in Los Angeles shooting a movie and my phone rang.
I was on the way to set at like 6:00am in California,
and I answered the phone.
I was like, “Hello?”
He’s like, “Hey, how are you Jack?”
I was like, “Who is this?”
He says, “Your governor, Andy Beshear.”
He was just giving me a call,
he didn’t want anything.
He was checking on me.
He was telling me he loved what I was doing,
and for the last year and a half
we’ve been staying in touch
and having that type of relationship.
Its been very organic.
We’ve been having dinners,
getting to know each other.
And I just want to say
this is a hell of a stand up guy right here.
So I think y’all are all holding the right signs.
And I want to encourage everybody
to get out there and vote.
You know what to do, man.
Thank you so much.
VOTE KENTUCKY
VOTE EARLY!
OPEN

spoken_summary: Rapper Jack Harlow thanks Governor Andy Beshear and the crowd, then recounts how Beshear called him out of the blue a year and a half ago just to check in. Harlow describes their subsequent friendship as 'very organic' and praises Beshear as 'a hell of a stand-up guy,' before encouraging the crowd to vote.
audio_music: The audio consists of Jack Harlow speaking live into a microphone, with the ambient sounds of a large, enthusiastic crowd cheering in the background. There is no music.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, continuous, handheld shot from the perspective of someone in the crowd, with no cuts or special editing effects.
central_claim: Rapper Jack Harlow personally endorses Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear, portraying him as a genuine and caring person to encourage young people to vote for him.
intended_effect: To leverage Jack Harlow's celebrity appeal to persuade young voters to support Andy Beshear, making the candidate seem relatable and authentic.
